definition: A tape recorder captures audio by magnetically recording it on moving tape and can reproduce the recorded signal during playback.
entry_text: A tape recorder captures audio by magnetically recording it on moving tape and can reproduce the recorded signal during playback.
example: An archivist plays a recorded interview on compatible equipment for digitization.
label: Tape recorder
sense_note: Interpreted as audio tape recording; magnetic tape also supports data or video recording.
